proof_layers.responsibility: Overlapped native I/O must receive contiguous host bytes valid until operation completion, and those bytes must be reclaimed on the original request cleanup paths.
proof_layers.original_limitation: Original VrReadWriteAsyncNmPipe converts arbitrary far buffers with READ_FAR_POINTER -> original vrdisp::_inlinePointerFromWords -> GetVDMAddr -> Sim32pGetVDMPointer, then submits that single pointer directly. Original SIM32 maps the first byte only; a supported noncontiguous CCPU page span is not contiguous host storage. Historical real CCPU counterexample is linked below, not a new runtime pass.
proof_layers.specific_difference: Original request queue supports concurrent outstanding operations. Buffer remains the guest far value consumed by VrNmPipeInterrupt DS:SI; Next and HANDLE are live original fields, OVERLAPPED is OS-owned. A single host state pointer supplies ownership of the per-request staging allocation through original completion/dequeue/free. This does not prove every private-state member or all async policies necessary.
